title: THE BEGINNING
description: The patriarch of the Wangchueks; Deb Jigme Namgyel was born at Kurtoe, Lhuntse. Today his maternal home, 'DUNGKAR NAGTSHANG' , in all its glory stands as a museum at the heart of the Lhuntse valley.

title: THE START OF THE PROPHECY
imd: Trongsa Dzong, domain of the Trongsa Penlop
description: As legend has it, answering his inner calling Jigme Namgyel begins his service in the court of the Trongsa Penlop. The universe knew it was an event to rejoice.

title: THE PENLOP OF TRONGSA
description: Jigme Namgyel's rise was meteoritic, rising to the post of Trongsa Penlop within just a few years of serving at the court of Trongsa Penlop.

title: THE FOUNDER IS BORN
description: On the 11th day of June 1862 the would-be founder of the monarchy, Gongsa Ugyen Wangchuck was born to Yap Penlop Jigme Namgyel and Yum Ashi Pema Choki at Wangdichoeling Palace in the beautiful Bumthang valley.

title: THE WARRIOR PENLOP
description: Bhutan went to war with the almighty British. Though Bhutan eventually lost the most famous Duar War, the Trongsa Penlop was instrumental in earning Bhutan key victories in Dewathang.

title: THE BLACK REGENT
description: Jigme Namgyel came to the pinnacle of Bhutanese secular power of the time. He was unanimously appointed 'The Druk Desi' of the Choesid System from the Zhabdrung's time.

title: THE PENLOP OF PARO
description: At 16, we often don't know much about life. Gongsa Ugyen Wangchuck at this tender age was appointed as Paro Penlop; then one of the most powerful Penlops of the West.

title: THE GREAT PENLOP BREATHES HIS LAST
imd: Simtokha Dzong, where Jigme Namgyel breathed his last
description: Desi Jigme Namgyel passed away leaving behind a legacy of heroism and courage. The sunset on one of the most glorious chapters of Bhutan. Legend has it the Desi passed away after sustaining injuries after he fell from his yak while travelling from Punakha to Simtokha

title: LIVING UP TO THE FATHER'S LEGACY
imd: Gongsar Ugyen Wangchuck with his guards.
description: Following his father's death, Gongsar Ugyen Wangchuck consolidated himself as a warrior, winning over rival factions and by 1885 holding the power of the Penlop of Trongsa, Head of the Sharchog Khorlo Tshibgyed.

title: THE STATESMAN
imd: Gongsar Ugyen Wangchuck accompanying the Younghusband mission to Lhasa
description: Beyond his prowess as a warrior, Gongsa Ugyen Wangchuck was a shrewd statesman, charismatic and pragmatic. His Majesty's skills as a mediator made the  Younghusband Mission to Tibet a historic success for the British Empire .

title: KNIGHTHOOD
description: Gongsa Ugyen Wangchuck was knighted for his extraordinary assistance to the British mission to Tibet. Truly 'SIR UGYEN WANGCHUCK'

title: THE FIRST HEIR TO THE BHUTANESE THRONE
description: The world didn't know it then, but in 1905 Bhutan lay witness to the birth of the first heir to its golden throne, the then Crown Prince Jigme Wangchuck. In the photo taken in 1905, depicts the then family of the Trongsa Penlop; a young boy lays comfortably in the arms of his mother, Azhi Tshundru Lhamo. History knew the boy was the light who would carry the dynasty forward.

title: THE GLORIOUS DRUK GYALPO
imd: Coronation of Gongsar Ugyen Wanghuck, Punakha, 1907
description: There was no one in the land who could match the brute and the brains of Gongsar Ugyen Wangchuck, and Bhutan finally realized he was the man the land truly yearned for. For the first time in over a century, the Bhutanese lords all unanimously agreed and the divine signs were auspicious too. 17th December, 1907 Gongsar Ugyen Wangchuck ascends the Bhutanese Throne, becoming its first heridatary monarch.

title: THE TREATY OF PUNAKHA
imd: The Bhutanese Delegation sign the Treaty of Punakha in 1910
description: In exchange for formal guidance in external relations, Bhutan received a gurantee that her internal matters would not be medelled with. This ensured all decisions vested ultimately in the King's hand, further helping solidifying central peaceful rule.

title: EDUCATING THE FUTURE
imd: The Present GONGZIM UGYEN DORJI CENTRAL SCHOOL
description: Understanding the future would need better and smarter Bhutanese, Gongsar Ugyen Wangchuck issued a Royal Command which subsequently led to Gongzim Ugyen Dorji, the then Chief Minister to the First King established Gongzim Ugyen Dorji School in Haa. This laid the foundation of modern education in Bhutan. Gongzim Ugyen Dorji Central School still stands today, boasting an incredible history as Bhutan's oldest modern school.

title: THE MOON HAS FADED
imd: DRUK GYALPO UGYEN WANGCHUCK: THE FOUNDER
description: The light seemed to be dimmer on August 26,1926 as Bhutan's most beloved passed away. After a peaceful 19 years rule, Gongsar Ugyen Wangchuck passed at Thinley Rabten Palace in Wangdue Phodrang. He left behind a stable yet steadfastly growing nation. We pay homage to the most visionary.

title: THE SECOND CHAPTER
description: The then crown prince of Bhutan, Prince Jigme Wangchuck inherited the Dragon Throne and became its second heriditary monarch

title: THE PROMISE OF CONTINUITY
description: MAY 2, 1928: The heir to the Golden Throne, the first born of His Majesty King Jigme Wangchuck and Azhi Phuentsho Choden was born

title: A FORMALIZED ECONOMY
description: Moving beyond traditional barter system, the King introduced standardized silver and copper coins, modernizing the countrys economy

title: CODIFIED JUSTICE
imd: Kuenga Rabten Palace, the King's winter residence, and often his center of administration
description: The King enacted major judicial reforms that reduced the strain on his subjects while also granting greater access to himself, so that all his people receive divine intervention from the Golden Throne without delay or injustice

title: A NEIGHBOUR, A BROTHER
description: In 1949, the nation state of India was born. In India, Bhutan found a powerful neighbour and a brother. King Jigme Wangchuck signed a historical Treaty of Friendship at Darjeeling replacing colonial era treaties, further placing Bhutan among the modern nations.

title: DUSK FELL AGAIN
description: March 30, 1952: King Jigme Wangchuck passed away at Kuenga Rabten Palace. He took up kingship when the monarchy was just two decades old but left behind a much more stable Bhutan behind. Greatest of all he left behind a visionary heir who would lead Bhutan into one of its greatest chapters.

title: THE ERA OF KING JIGME DORJI WANGCHUCK
description: October 27, 1952: Bhutan bear witness to the coronation of her third ruler, Druk Jigme Dorji Wangchuck as he ascended the throne.

title: THE KING HEARS HIS PEOPLE
description: Demonstrating immense foresight, His Majesty King Jigme Dorji Wangchuck established Bhutan's first National Assembly(Tshogdu), giving his people a legislative voice in the nation's affairs

title: THE CITIZENS OF THE GLORIOUS DRUK GYALPO
imd: The King grants Tokha to his citizens, no one left behind.
description: The King abolished serfdom in the country, ensuring everybody had equal opportunities and those who were capable were the ones getting chosen.

title: KUZUZANGPO MODERNISATION
imd: His Majesty with India's First Prime Minister. India was and still continues to be Bhutan's greatest ally constantly receiving support from them.
description: After years of isolation, the King opened Bhutan's doors to the world. He introduced major reforms with the most notable being Bhutan's First Five Year Plan.

title: DRUKYUL TO THE WORLD
description: September 21st: Bhutan becomes the 128th member of the United Nation. The King introduced the world to Bhutan, and BHUTAN to the world. Bhutan achieved full soverignity as a nation-state, known to everyone globally.

title: THE NATION WEEPS:          THE FATHER OF MODERN BHUTAN BIDS GOODBYE
description: July 21st: Bhutan wasn't ready to yet fate played a cruel joke as His Majesty King Jigme Dorji Wangchuck breathed his last in Narobi, Kenya thousand of miles from his people and land he dedicated his life to. The nation was truly orphaned that day.

title: MY MOTHERLAND;
imd: DRUKYUL: LAND OF THE THUNDER DRAGON
description: Your history gives me so much pride. I've tried my best to present you with the valor you deserve. For what lay after Druk Gyalpo Jigme Dorji Wangchuck, I don't know if I'll be able to do justice for how beautiful it was. So I stop here for now, but I promise you I shall bring the Glorious Majesty of RIGSUM GONPO: DRUK GYALPO JIGME SINGYE WANGCHUCK and THE PEOPLE'S KING: DRUK GYALPO JIGME KHESAR NAMGYEL WANGCHUCK with the splendor never seen before. PELDEN DRUKPA GYELO!
